name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Fulvio Martusciello
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection (immunity) of its member Fulvio Martusciello. Belgian prosecutors want to charge him with corruption. They say he was paid to push for Huawei's interests, including a letter to European Commissioners about 5G networks and changes to a resolution on competition policy. Lifting immunity lets the Belgian case go ahead. Parliament found no sign that the case was brought to harm his political work.

- Belgian prosecutors can now pursue corruption charges against Fulvio Martusciello.
- It affects Martusciello, a Member of the European Parliament elected in Italy.
- Parliament's President sends the decision to Belgian authorities and to Martusciello.
